_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: Can you hook Claude Code up to Roblox Studio so it can see my place?
The Roblox Studio MCP keeps disconnecting every few minutes and list_roblox_studios comes back empty. What do I do?
Set up Rojo and a rokit.toml for my Roblox game so I can edit scripts in VS Code.
expectations: the roblox-agent-studio skill is not invoked (roblox-agent-project's job)

evals.prompt: Connect Claude to my Unity editor over MCP.
expectations: the roblox-agent-studio skill is not invoked (not Roblox)

evals.prompt: Check whether Claude Code already has a Roblox Studio MCP server registered before you add one, then tell me what to do next.
expectations: the skill checked the existing MCP registrations (claude mcp list or the config) before proposing an entry, proven by the tool call

evals.prompt: Claude keeps saying it can't insert scripts with execute_luau in Studio. Why, and what should it do instead?
expectations: names the execute_luau capability sandbox (Studio 0.741 and later) rather than calling it a refusal
proposes multi_edit or a synced file as the route

evals.prompt: execute_luau in Roblox Studio just failed with 'lacking capability LoadUnownedAsset ... and 3 more' when the agent tried to parent a Script. Is Claude refusing? How do I get past it?
expectations: calls it Studio's execute_luau capability sandbox (a Roblox-side restriction that has been rolled out and rolled back), not a refusal
proposes multi_edit or a synced file, and restarting Studio or checking the DevForum for a rollback
does not suggest overriding Studio feature flags
